source: flow_graph/plant_flow_graph.json node FLUE_KO (graph revision AD); docs-authority/duties/FLUE_KO.md sections 3, 4 and 6; docs-authority/nozzles/FLUE_KO.csv; flow_graph/placement_seed.json; Generated by models/mfg/tracker.py (AQS-PLAN-006 section 6). Not edited by hand.
size_basis: study default envelope box, read back from the cad/stl registry (M0 study envelope; design sizing per the duty sheet follows)
material: FRP vinyl ester with C-veil liner, PVDF mesh pad, borosilicate glass 3.3 inlet spool (AQS-STD-002 section 4.3). No metal wetted part. S67 at 300 °C is spray-quenched in the glass inlet spool by IA-FLUE-QUENCH, 24.31 kg/d tower water from ROOF_TANK (X-SAF-07): 30 439 kJ/d removed cooling to 60 °C evaporates 12.15 kg/d; spray is 2.0 times evaporation (assumption) so the spool stays wetted. Gas leaves the spool at about 60 °C, below the FRP vinyl ester limit. Loss of quench water trips the afterburner flue damper (held for X-CTL).

envelope.basis: study registry box (params size_note; matches the fab study page); the duty sheet section 4 line is a unit-task-04 placeholder (W12)

design.service: flue knock-out: 300 C S67 quenched in the glass spool to below the FRP limit, condensate knocked out, gas to the NOx scrubber (duty sections 1, 3 and 6)
design.internals: glass inlet spool + PVDF mesh pad (duty section 3); weir + launder layout solids from the separation duty

layout.frame: origin at the envelope corner; shell axis at x 500, y 300, z up
layout.nozzle_spread: the schedule gives face and height only; ports pack centred on the face mid-length; per-tag positions in check.nozzles_drawn
layout.vent_drain: N7 vent flush at the top head (the 800 datum IS the box top); N6 drain boss on the base head, tip at the 50 datum
layout.hardware_idiom: connection hardware flush at the envelope faces; nothing protrudes, bbox within the node envelope
